pluck.englishDescription: To pull at a thing stuck somewhere so as to make it come out.

praiseworthy.englishDescription: An attitude and behavior being nice and praiseworthy.
Someone's remark or behavior being surprising and lovable, and deserving to be boasted.

praiseworthy.englishDescription: One's work, character, etc., being great and making others proud.

regiment.definitionKo: 사단보다 작고 대대보다 큰, 군대 조직상의 한 단위.
regiment.englishDescription: The army unit smaller than a division and larger than a battalion.

semi-permanent.definitionKo: 오랜 세월이 흘러도 거의 변하지 않는.
semi-permanent.englishDescription: Staying almost unchanged even as time passes.

shoulder.englishDescription: A road made on both sides of a wide road or highway for broken down vehicles or vehicles in a hurry.

shoulder.englishDescription: The body part between the lower end of the neck and the upper end of the arm.

shoulder.englishDescription: The part between the sleeve seam and the collar.

subacidity.englishDescription: A state of being slightly acid.

utmost.definitionKo: 더할 수 없이 매우 심한 정도.
utmost.englishDescription: The degree of being extremely severe.

utmost.definitionKo: 한 가지 일에 온 힘을 다함.

utmost.definitionKo: 있는 힘을 다함. 또는 낼 수 있는 모든 힘.
